label: Q-01
title: Borrow/allowance = calculateClaimAmount*1.01 with a false '~10% over-estimate' premise; DOLA runs with only 1% headroom, and over-delivery beyond it reverts the claim
description: Borrow buffer sized on a wrong premise (story-002 Background, repeated in NatSpec L265-268): calculateClaimAmount's over-estimate is strategy-dependent and is exact for DOLA. The 1% buffer applies to the aggregate estimate.
impact: Loud DoS only (SYA safeTransferFrom reverts on allowance); caller must exempt the over-delivering strategy. No loss. Story/NatSpec safety premise is factually false (Law 2).
severityRationale: Resolved flagged question 2 as QA/Info, not Low. The revert path needs a strategy that delivers more than its own same-transaction calculateClaimAmount estimate by >1%. No live strategy does: fork measurements show paid/estimate of 99.00% (USDC), 75.12% (USDe), 100.00% (DOLA), all at or below the estimate. The DOLA-only sharpening shows the headroom shrinks to exactly 1% when others are exempted, but headroom is only consumed by over-delivery, which is unobserved on live code; the invariant failures used a synthetic +2-3% over-delivering double. Impact even then is a loud atomic revert with no loss. What is real is the false '~10% over-estimate, safe direction' premise in story-002 and NatSpec L265-268; it is routed to spec-conformance as F-04 so the owner sees it, and becomes Low if SYA ever adds a strategy whose delivery can exceed its estimate. The SYMBOLIC-002 sub-observation (buffer floors to 0 below 100 units) is dust.
recommendation: Correct story-002's premise and the NatSpec; size BORROW_BUFFER_BPS from measured worst-case delivery/estimate (per strategy, not aggregate); add a MockSYA over-delivery mode (DEDUP-010(3)).

evidence.invariantSharpening: invariant_liveness_overDelivery FAIL (adversarial, forge+medusa): USDe ~3% over estimate -> ERC20InsufficientAllowance. Tripwire refinement: the 1% buffer is on the AGGREGATE estimate, so a +2% DOLA over-delivery is absorbed in a full claim (1545.3 borrowed vs 1539 paid) but reverts in a DOLA-only claim (454.5 vs 459). Exposure is largest exactly when the caller exempts the over-estimating strategies (USDe 75%, USDC 99%) and leaves DOLA - the operator's natural reaction to other failures (e.g. DEDUP-002) removes the headroom.
evidence.symbolic: SYMBOLIC-003 (testFuzz_C6) witness: 1.28% over-delivery -> pull > borrow -> revert. SYMBOLIC-002 (testFuzz_C2): owed = est*10100/10000 floors the 1% headroom to zero for est < 100 reward-token units (< 0.0001 USDC) - dust-level sub-observation. C4 bounded fuzz: delivered_i <= estimate_i => pull <= owed (not a proof; silent on over-delivery).
evidence.patternContext: PATTERN-OBS-04 independently noted actualPayment > owed reverts loudly.

faithfulness.specText: story-002 Background: "`calculateClaimAmount` (lines 777-814) applies the same skips and sums `totalBalanceOf − principalOf` ... On live strategies it **over-estimates by about 10%** ... This is the safe direction"; Concern [Borrow over-estimate]: "...on top of `BORROW_BUFFER_BPS = 100`. This is the safe direction ... No change needed."
faithfulness.deviation: The code meets the story's behavioural criterion (borrow = calc*1.01, with the excess settled back). The story's safety reasoning is false for at least one live strategy, so the 'safe direction' assurance does not hold as written. A strategy that delivers more than estimate*1.01 would revert the claim on SYA's allowance pull. That is a loud DoS, not a loss.
